caption:
Stop stuffing new pillow covers with your old flat inserts

Covers look full in the package, then go limp the second they're on the couch. The problem usually isn't the cover at all. It's an insert that's already lost its shape.

An 18x18 insert sized to match your cover, not squeezed from a different size, is what keeps corners square instead of round. This pair sits at over 220,000 reviews and a 4.6 rating.

Two 18x18 inserts with 100% virgin filling for about $17, so both sides of the couch match.
